hero.description: Computer Science student and IT professional with experience in database administration and management. I also have experience in application development using C#/.NET. Focused on problem-solving, process optimization, and building software solutions.
about.p1: Computer Science student and developer with experience in database administration and management, currently working with SQL Server. I also have experience in application development using C# and .NET, with knowledge in software design and layered architecture.

about.p3: Currently in my third year of Computer Science, complementing my professional experience with comprehensive training in software development, databases, and systems architecture.
